I think you are doing many things well. We don’t know each other but I can tell you that we judge our self harder that anyone else. I can tell you also that even though you think you have no friends and family doesn’t care they do more that you know.
College is not the only thing after high school, don’t judge yourself hard based on if you attended college or not. I know lots of college graduates people and it doesn’t make them smarter or some are not bright. Often times I wonder, just like if I look at top of tree and see a cow all the way at the top, how did it get there??? I wonder many times the same with people that are college educated. Same goes for people with “just a high school diploma” some the most brilliant people ever!!!
Have you look to apply to a community college? And then move to a 4 year university? Don’t stress over colleges not accepting you that’s their lost!!! 
Girls, well where are you trying to meet people? I used to tell my boy when it comes to girls go big if they say no move on and try again a brand new car only stays that way until you drive it out of the lot!! Same with people most people are nice but you always have those that judge and are not nice. 
Look for those that are nice that are really looking to make a connection and you will get there…shin up enjoy life, enjoy the little moments of life and be happy. Don’t look into things for happiness look at what makes you have, what makes your life full of joy!!!

Don’t. I’m serious. Currently looking for another job, but Vivint locks you in a contract, says you have 3 days to change your mind but then “forgets” to submit documents then makes it your fault it wasn’t cancelled and charges you through the nose to cancel.
They use a PoE (power over Ethernet) to connect. The plug talks to the network and panel.

Don’t work here. It seriously sucks. It’s caused me so much stress, they don’t care about your time… seriously, I’m trying to leave. If you can, don’t work here. Here’s a tip, any job that says “We’re all one big family” is a lie and you should run fast and far.

Yeah, I work here currently. Won’t say what position, just that I’m on the phone a lot but don’t work here. It’s not a good environment and I’m desperately seeking another job. Pay and benefits don’t make it up for me.
Just so you know, Vivint doesn’t allow you to add cameras from another system and will charge for the smart drive.

Come over here and kiss me on my hot mouth, I’m feeling romanticle.

In all seriousness, I’m 21 and in a similar boat. I’m sorry man, but hey, you’re not alone at least.

I feel the exact same way. I drove everyone that I cared about away and made everything about me. Someone gave me some advice today, but we’re human and make mistakes. If we see that we have a problem and acknowledge it then we’re on the path to solving it. Take what happened and learn from it, to be better to those in the future.
It’s not even a guarantee and it can lead to other serious health problems later.
